dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: 真实数据接入可能伤害公共信任。
dimensions.mitigation: 仅匿名聚合、最小化、人工复核、删除和退出。
dimensions.human_review: 由隐私与专业团队在任何真实数据接入前复核。

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: 三节点、双翼和人工回退需要跨专业协作。
dimensions.mitigation: 先最小组件包、再小规模协议、最后决定是否扩散。
dimensions.human_review: 由实施团队在每期闸门评审。

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: AI 归并可能遮蔽少数意见。
dimensions.mitigation: 议事、公示、保留相反意见和年度公开报告。
dimensions.human_review: 由社区参与者与主持人复核。

dimensions.label: 运营成本
dimensions.note: 巡检、审校、人工接管和活动成本未知。
dimensions.mitigation: 轮换、分级、过期降级和先定责任再扩散。
dimensions.human_review: 由运营方与财务/公共服务团队待核。

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: 控规、蓝线、遗产和数据规则资料尚不完整。
dimensions.mitigation: 所有结论标 provisional/to_verify/unknown，不替代审批。
dimensions.human_review: 由规划、交通、水务和法务专业团队复核。

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: 临时几何可能被误读为官方红线。
dimensions.mitigation: 官方边界到位即重画并复算，当前图层只作示意。
dimensions.human_review: 由测绘与规划团队复核。

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: 原型可能失效、过期或误导。
dimensions.mitigation: 三项协议、小规模、人工回退和停止条件。
dimensions.human_review: 由试验管理员和无障碍顾问复核。

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: 数字优先可能排除老年人、残障者和低带宽用户。
dimensions.mitigation: 纸本、语音、大字、英文、人工服务与退出并行。
dimensions.human_review: 由无障碍顾问和多元参与者复核。

risks.risk_en: Individual profiling, continuous traces, or sensitive data enter a public scenario
risks.risk_zh: 个体画像、连续轨迹或敏感数据进入公共场景
risks.mitigation_zh: 匿名聚合、虚拟数据、最小化、人工复核、删除与退出；禁止人脸/声纹/过度监控
risks.mitigation_en: Use anonymous aggregation, synthetic data, minimization, human review, deletion, and exit; prohibit face, voiceprint, and excessive monitoring.

risks.risk_en: Temporary geometry is misread as an official boundary or engineering conclusion
risks.risk_zh: 临时几何被误读为官方边界或工程结论
risks.mitigation_zh: 显式 provisional、图层属性和复算触发条件；官方资料到位后重画
risks.mitigation_en: State provisional status, layer attributes, and recalculation triggers; redraw when official material arrives.

risks.risk_en: Blue-line, river-management, flood, and ecological data are incomplete
risks.risk_zh: 蓝线、河道管理、防洪、生态资料缺失
risks.mitigation_zh: 水边活动只做概念观察与可撤组件，不作工程结论
risks.mitigation_en: Keep water-edge activity to conceptual observation and removable components; make no engineering conclusion.

risks.risk_en: Digital-first service excludes older people, disabled people, low-bandwidth users, or international visitors
risks.risk_zh: 数字优先排除老年人、残障者、低带宽用户或国际访客
risks.mitigation_zh: 纸本、语音、大字、英文和人工并行；场景卡设可退出与停止条件
risks.mitigation_en: Run paper, audio, large type, English, and human service in parallel; keep exit and stop conditions in every card.

risks.risk_en: A prototype fails or a model produces inaccurate output
risks.risk_zh: 原型失效或模型生成不准确
risks.mitigation_zh: 三项协议、小规模、来源卡、过期降级、人工回退
risks.mitigation_en: Use three protocols, small scale, source cards, stale-status downgrade, and human fallback.

risks.risk_en: AI aggregation hides minority views or creates an illusion of automation
risks.risk_zh: AI 归并掩盖少数意见或造成自动化错觉
risks.mitigation_zh: 议事、公示、保留相反意见、年度公开报告
risks.mitigation_en: Use deliberation, disclosure, preserved dissent, and an annual public report.

risks.risk_en: Human takeover, inspection, content review, and event-operation costs are unknown
risks.risk_zh: 人工接管、巡检、内容审校和活动运营成本未知
risks.mitigation_zh: 先做最小组件包和轮换试点，先定责任再扩散
risks.mitigation_en: Start with a minimum component kit and rotating test; assign responsibility before expansion.

risks.risk_en: Rights for historic material, fonts, case imagery, or trademarks are unclear
risks.risk_zh: 历史材料、字体、案例图像或商标权利不清
risks.mitigation_zh: 原创图形/几何、清权文本、无第三方视觉复用；发布前逐项复核
risks.mitigation_en: Use original graphics/geometry and cleared text only; reuse no third-party visuals and review each item before publication.
